item.title: SilverStone RM4A: 4U Rackmount Server/Workstation Chassis That's Great For Liquid Cooling
item.description: For those looking to build a rackmount-ready server or workstation that can handle up to an SSI-EEB motherboard and capable of fitting a large liquid cooling setup, the RM4A is a new option from SilverStone that can fit up to a 360mm radiator while still fitting an SSI-EEB motherboard and up to eight expansion slots within 4U size constraints.
